title: Why the roadmap must be a file
thesis: A plan that is not a file under version control, checked by the build, is not a plan.

nodes.text: A plan lives where the work lives, or it is not read.

evidence.filled_by: last three retrospectives: checked-in plans survived, wiki plans died

nodes.text: A plan and a codebase drift the moment either moves, and the drift is silent.
A mechanical check closes the gap: it cannot forget.

evidence.filled_by: March 2024 script; stale entries eleven to zero in a month

nodes.text: The forced-edit objection is true and does not matter: the check buys the impossibility of silent edits, not thoughtful ones.

evidence.filled_by: the objection as stated in the brief

nodes.text: The rule: file, next to the code, build fails on disagreement.
Is there a concrete drift incident to open the section with, or does it stay abstract?
